### Problem

The wordpress.org listing of 1.0.0 is built from `readme.txt` and `.wordpress-org/`, and today it would show a development log, not a first release. The `= 1.0.0 =` changelog holds 33 bullets written while the plugin was being built ("no longer…", "instead of…", "as before", "after the update", "a site that had a page chosen keeps…"), and `changelog.d/` holds 20 more fragments the release would add to it. Some of them contradict each other or the code: the readme bullet says the required-fields step after sign-in is asked and can be skipped, while `changelog.d/188.md` says that step is Users+ Pro's; `changelog.d/228.md` announces that signing in with the public name "is gone", which a first release never had. For people installing 1.0.0, none of these changed anything: there was no earlier version.

`readme.txt` is 26 KB, half of it that changelog and a multisite FAQ answer of about 4 KB. The 13 screenshots were last taken on 8 October 2026 (#20); since then Registration became a screen of its own (#190), the Pro previews changed (#189), the account area's boxes, colours and photo changed (#183, #213, #224, #226), and Access › Summary gained its "Right now" rail (#210). Screenshot 5 (Overview) does not show the "first steps" its caption promises.

### Scope

- Replace the `= 1.0.0 =` changelog with a short first-release entry: the line `Unreleased.` (kept exactly as it is, first line under `= 1.0.0 =`), then `First public release.` and at most 8 bullets naming what 1.0.0 brings, true for the free plugin alone.
- Delete every file in `changelog.d/` (they describe changes between unreleased builds), keeping the directory if the release script needs it.
- Check every claim in `== Description ==`, `== Installation ==`, `== Privacy ==` and `== Frequently Asked Questions ==` against the code on `main`, after the moves to Users+ Pro (#188, #189), and correct the ones that are not true for the free plugin alone. Pro may be named only as a separate add-on, as now.
- Shorten `readme.txt`: the multisite FAQ answer to what a site administrator needs to decide (the rest stays in `docs/`), and any other passage that repeats what a screen already says.
- Retake the 13 listing screenshots from the current UI (`make screenshots`) and make each caption in `== Screenshots ==` describe what its image shows.

### Out of scope

- Removing the `Unreleased.` line, the version markers, `Stable tag`, `Tested up to`, `Requires at least` and `Requires PHP` (7.1, 6.2 and 8.0 are current).
- The banners and icons (`banner-772x250`, `banner-1544x500`, `icon-128x128`, `icon-256x256` already have the sizes wordpress.org asks for).
- The destination of the "Learn about Users+ Pro" links (`diluxone_users_pro_url()`), decided separately.
- Any change to PHP, CSS or JavaScript.

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given `readme.txt` on the branch, when its `= 1.0.0 =` entry is read, then its first line is `Unreleased.`, it says `First public release.`, it has at most 8 bullets, and none of them contains "no longer", "instead of", "as before", "now " or "after the update".
C2: Given the branch, when `changelog.d/` is listed, then it holds no `*.md` fragment.
C3: Given `readme.txt` on the branch, when its size is measured, then it is under 14,000 bytes and `make plugin-check` passes with no error or warning.
C4: Given each feature claim of `== Description ==` and `== Frequently Asked Questions ==`, when it is checked against the free plugin on `main` with Users+ Pro absent, then it is true, and the pull request lists every claim it changed with the file and function that settles it.
C5: Given the 13 files `.wordpress-org/screenshot-N.png` on the branch, when compared with the current UI, then each was retaken by `make screenshots` on this branch and caption N of `== Screenshots ==` describes what image N shows.

### Criticality

Normal
